translations.web: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
translations.bsb: With her great persuasion she entices him; with her flattering lips she lures him.
translations.kjv: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced
translations.asv: With her much fair speech she causeth him to yield; With the flattering of her lips she forceth him along.
